purpose: measure whether a real batch-8 pi0.5 step fits on one admissible GPU before any long run is started
initialisation: pi05_libero parameter checkpoint, new LoRA, no resume of the E3.1 single-episode checkpoint

gpu_admission.policy: free memory must cover the measured peak plus margin; utilisation is explicitly not an admission gate
gpu_admission.training_admission_derivation: the sampled peak on that card includes 7,202 MiB held by another job, so this run's own footprint is about 15,545 MiB; the 30,000-update run therefore asks for 15,500 MiB plus the 1,500 MiB margin, and the computed preallocation fraction is capped at 0.80 by the launcher (never the old hard-coded 0.95)

result.conclusion: batch 8 fits on this card with the computed preallocation fraction; the 4/2/1 fallback was not needed

scope_note: memory probe only; it is not counted as a training run, no updates from it are used, and the 30k run did not start because the E4-T data gate did not pass
claim: throughput and memory measurement of one real optimizer step, not a learning result
status_update_20261026: superseded for this field: the 30,000-update run was started after pilot v14 passed and the data gate closed; the probe itself remains a single optimizer step and its updates still do not count toward the run
